provenance.board_ms_semantics: native physical simulation milliseconds, not a hardware clock reading
provenance.control_epoch_semantics: actual completed RTL fast transaction count
provenance.request_id_semantics: offline replay task identifier1; no hardware PLAY ACK is claimed
provenance.coherent_semantics: native transaction phase/finite-field checks passed; not a UART coherence flag
provenance.endpoint_calculation: exact sampled frame_actual at t and t-46000ms
provenance.model_scope: Historical conditional quiet-V3/ADC16 fit; parameters NOT calibrated to ADC64 or V5
